name: MG400 z hop
description: Robot 5 (Dobot MG400, type: mg400) goes to its configured home_position, lifts the flange by 5 mm, waits one second, lowers it by 5 mm and returns home. Every move is a straight MovL inside the robot's own workspace box of examples/mg400/config.mg400.yaml; the real run is the human's (knowledge/mg400-commissioning.md stage C2).
